==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
In this world, people use glowing blue orbs to capture and summon monsters. I am at an academy for monster summoning. I accidentally capture a fellow student inside a blue orb and I find myself running away from the school's security team.

The school's security team resembles a group of men in black agents. They are all dressed in black suits with black sunglasses, which makes them look fairly normal compared to everyone else. The dress code at the academy for students and teachers mandates that people wear shirts with poofy sleeves, hats with feathers on them, and colorful capes.

I manage to evade the security team, by hiding under a set of wooden bleachers. I escape the school and suddenly find myself watching replays of a monster battling tournament that I was in. Apparently tournaments have an amnesia like effect on participants, so you have to watch the replays to remember if you were even there.

I realize that I won the tournament, but I wake up before I could really celebrate my victory.
